dm-subplots-removed.message:
`dm.subplots` and `dm.figure` were REMOVED — accessing them now
raises `AttributeError`. Use `plt.subplots(figsize=dm.figsize(...))`
(or `plt.figure(figsize=dm.figsize(...))` for custom GridSpec).
Apply style separately via `dm.style.use(...)`.
dm-subplots-removed.why:
Both functions were thin wrappers around `plt.subplots` / `plt.figure`
that bundled style mutation, polymorphic `width=`, and a deny-list
of legacy kwargs. Removing them keeps the matplotlib API native and
reduces dartwork-mpl's surface to a single sizing helper.

cm2in-figsize.message:
`figsize=(dm.cm2in(...), dm.cm2in(...))` is the legacy 0.3
pattern: `dm.cm2in` itself raises `AttributeError`. Use
`figsize=dm.figsize("<n>cm", "<aspect>")` instead.

dm-spines-removed.message:
`dm.style_spines`, `dm.add_grid`, and `dm.minimal_axes` were
REMOVED in 0.4.1 (#156). They were thin matplotlib wrappers
whose only contribution was curated default kwargs. Inline the
raw matplotlib calls instead, or copy a snippet from
`docs/usage_guide/recipes.md` (publication grid, minimal axes,
thin gray spines).

dm-legacy-wrappers-removed.message:
These legacy `dm.*` helpers were REMOVED in 0.4.1. They were
thin formatter, spine, margin, and figure wrappers around native
matplotlib calls. Inline the matplotlib API directly, or use the
recipes in `docs/migration.md` / `docs/usage_guide/recipes.md`;
dartwork-mpl keeps recipes and utilities rather than wrapper
functions for simple matplotlib operations.

dm-auto-select-colors-renamed.message:
`auto_select_colors` was renamed to `make_palette` in 0.4.1
(#156) for vocabulary alignment with `make_offset`.
Argument cleanup at the same time:
`n_series` → `n`, `color_type` → `kind`,
`highlight_index` → `highlight`.

dm-auto-layout-removed.message:
`dm.auto_layout` was REMOVED in 0.5.4 — accessing it now raises
`AttributeError`. Use `dm.simple_layout(fig, margin=...)`: the
legacy `padding` inches argument maps to `margin`;
`max_iter`/`tolerance` are obsolete (simple_layout is
direct-calc).

dm-named-renamed.message:
`dm.named` was REMOVED in 0.4.1 — the replacement is
`dm.color(...)`, a single string-parser entry point that accepts
token names, hex, and `rgb()`/`oklch()`/`oklab()` functional
strings.

dm-model-b-color-api-removed.message:
Version 0.6.0 removed the old palette, cycle, diagnostic,
and color-class vocabulary; there is no palette-version switch.
For current color operations use `dm.colors(...)`,
`dm.set_colors(...)`, `dm.list_colors()`, or `dm.show_colors()`.

dm-removed-namespaces.message:
`dm.agent_utils` and `dm.xplot` were REMOVED in 0.4. The
agent_utils surfaces moved to `dm.lint` / `dm.validate_figure` /
`dm.helpers`; the xplot templates now live in `dm.templates`
(e.g. `dm.templates.plot_diverging_bar`). See docs/migration.md.

dm-install-llm-txt-removed.message:
The `install_llm_txt` installer family
(`install_llm_txt`/`uninstall_llm_txt`/`INSTALL_TARGETS`) was
REMOVED in 0.5. The agent-doc corpus is read at runtime — use
`dm.get_agent_doc(name)` / `dm.agent_doc_path(name)`, or the MCP
`dartwork-mpl://guide/*` resources.

deprecated-width-token.message:
`dm.SW/MW/TW/DW/FS_*/WIDTHS` were REMOVED in 0.4.0 — accessing
them now raises `AttributeError`. Use
`figsize=dm.figsize("<n>cm", "<aspect>")`, or `dm.col1`/`dm.col2`
for academic columns.

SW.message: dm.SW was removed in 0.4. Use dm.col1 / dm.col2 / dm.cm(...) (e.g. width='9cm'). See docs/migration.md.

MW.message: dm.MW was removed in 0.4. Use dm.cm(...) (e.g. width='12cm'). See docs/migration.md.

TW.message: dm.TW was removed in 0.4. Use dm.cm(...) (e.g. width='14.5cm'). See docs/migration.md.

DW.message: dm.DW was removed in 0.4. Use dm.col2 / dm.cm(...) (e.g. width='17cm'). See docs/migration.md.

WIDTHS.message: dm.WIDTHS was removed in 0.4. Use iterate explicit widths inline. See docs/migration.md.

cm2in.message: dm.cm2in was removed in 0.4. Use dm.cm(...) (returns a Length; e.g. dm.figsize('13cm', ...)). See docs/migration.md.

subplots.message: dm.subplots was removed in 0.4. Use plt.subplots(figsize=dm.figsize('<n>cm', '<aspect>')) with a separate dm.style.use(...). See docs/migration.md.

figure.message: dm.figure was removed in 0.4. Use plt.figure(figsize=dm.figsize('<n>cm', '<aspect>')) with a separate dm.style.use(...). See docs/migration.md.

agent_utils.message: dm.agent_utils was removed in 0.4. Use dm.helpers (the agent_utils module was renamed to helpers). See docs/migration.md.

xplot.message: dm.xplot was removed in 0.4. Use dm.templates (e.g. dm.templates.plot_diverging_bar). See docs/migration.md.

auto_layout.message: dm.auto_layout was removed in 0.5.4. Use dm.simple_layout(fig, margin=...) (the legacy `padding` inches argument maps to `margin`; `max_iter`/`tolerance` are obsolete — simple_layout is direct-calc). See docs/migration.md.

install_llm_txt.message: dm.install_llm_txt was removed in 0.5. Use dm.agent_doc_path(name) / dm.get_agent_doc(name), or the MCP dartwork-mpl://guide/* resources. See docs/migration.md.

uninstall_llm_txt.message: dm.uninstall_llm_txt was removed in 0.5. Use dm.get_agent_doc(name) / the MCP resources (the corpus is read at runtime — there is no install to undo). See docs/migration.md.

INSTALL_TARGETS.message: dm.INSTALL_TARGETS was removed in 0.5. Use dm.get_agent_doc(name) / the MCP resources (install targets no longer exist). See docs/migration.md.

style_spines.message: dm.style_spines was removed in 0.4.1. Use raw matplotlib spine calls (ax.spines[s].set_color(...) / .set_linewidth(...)); see docs/usage_guide/recipes.md. See docs/migration.md.

add_grid.message: dm.add_grid was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.grid(True, color='oc.gray3', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5) plus ax.set_axisbelow(True). See docs/migration.md.

minimal_axes.message: dm.minimal_axes was removed in 0.4.1. Use the minimal-axes recipe in docs/usage_guide/recipes.md. See docs/migration.md.

auto_select_colors.message: dm.auto_select_colors was removed in 0.4.1. Use dm.make_palette(n, kind=..., highlight=...) (arguments renamed: n_series→n, color_type→kind, highlight_index→highlight). See docs/migration.md.

named.message: dm.named was removed in 0.4.1. Use dm.color(...) (accepts token names, hex, rgb()/oklch()/oklab()). See docs/migration.md.

format_axis_percent.message: dm.format_axis_percent was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0)) (from matplotlib import ticker). See docs/migration.md.

format_axis_labels.message: dm.format_axis_labels was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.StrMethodFormatter("{x:,.0f}")) (from matplotlib import ticker). See docs/migration.md.

format_axis_thousands.message: dm.format_axis_thousands was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: f"{x:,.0f}")) (from matplotlib import ticker). See docs/migration.md.

add_frame.message: dm.add_frame was removed in 0.4.1. Use fig.patches.append(plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, fill=False, transform=fig.transFigure)). See docs/migration.md.

add_value_labels.message: dm.add_value_labels was removed in 0.4.1. Use dm.label_bars(ax) (values on bars); dm.annotate_value(ax, x, y, text) for a point or a line end. See docs/migration.md.

set_xmargin.message: dm.set_xmargin was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.set_xmargin(...) (the matplotlib Axes method). See docs/migration.md.

set_ymargin.message: dm.set_ymargin was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.set_ymargin(...) (the matplotlib Axes method). See docs/migration.md.

hide_spines.message: dm.hide_spines was removed in 0.4.1. Use for s in ("top", "right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False). See docs/migration.md.

hide_all_spines.message: dm.hide_all_spines was removed in 0.4.1. Use for s in ax.spines: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False). See docs/migration.md.

show_only_spines.message: dm.show_only_spines was removed in 0.4.1. Use for s in ax.spines: ax.spines[s].set_visible(s in ("left", "bottom")). See docs/migration.md.

remove_grid.message: dm.remove_grid was removed in 0.4.1. Use ax.grid(False). See docs/migration.md.

save_figure.message: dm.save_figure was removed in 0.4.1. Use fig.savefig(...) (or dm.save_formats(fig, path) for multi-format). See docs/migration.md.

create_figure_with_style.message: dm.create_figure_with_style was removed in 0.4.1. Use dm.style.use(style); plt.subplots(figsize=dm.figsize("<n>cm", "<aspect>")). See docs/migration.md.

get_palette.message: dm.get_palette was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.colors(..., n=...) for lists or dm.set_colors(...) for cycles; see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

set_cycle.message: dm.set_cycle was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.set_colors(...); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

cycle.message: dm.cycle was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.colors('octave', n=8) or dm.set_colors(); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

cycle_cycler.message: dm.cycle_cycler was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.set_colors(..., styles=True); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

list_palettes.message: dm.list_palettes was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.list_colors(); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

list_colormaps.message: dm.list_colormaps was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.list_colors() or matplotlib.colormaps; see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

plot_colors.message: dm.plot_colors was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.show_colors(); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

plot_colormaps.message: dm.plot_colormaps was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.show_colors(); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

show_palette.message: dm.show_palette was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.show_colors(names=[...]); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

classify_colormap.message: dm.classify_colormap was removed in 0.6.0. Use dm.list_colors() metadata and dm.show_colors(); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

DartworkColor.message: dm.DartworkColor was removed in 0.6.0. Use documented color inputs such as color names, hex strings or RGB(A) tuples; see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

DartworkColormap.message: dm.DartworkColormap was removed in 0.6.0. Use matplotlib.colors.Colormap for colormap objects; see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

set_palette_version.message: dm.set_palette_version was removed in 0.6.0. Use the current color catalog (no palette-version switch exists); see docs/color_system. See docs/migration.md.

FS_SINGLE.message: dm.FS_SINGLE (0.3 figure-size tuple) was removed in 0.4. Use figsize=dm.figsize('<n>cm', '<aspect>'). See docs/migration.md.

FS_WIDE.message: dm.FS_WIDE (0.3 figure-size tuple) was removed in 0.4. Use figsize=dm.figsize('<n>cm', '<aspect>'). See docs/migration.md.

FS_lower.message: dm.FS_lower (0.3 figure-size tuple) was removed in 0.4. Use figsize=dm.figsize('<n>cm', '<aspect>'). See docs/migration.md.

FS_.message: dm.FS_ (0.3 figure-size tuple) was removed in 0.4. Use figsize=dm.figsize('<n>cm', '<aspect>'). See docs/migration.md.

lint_dartwork_mpl_code.description:
Analyze Python code against the dartwork-mpl anti-pattern
catalog (asset/prompt/02-anti-patterns.yaml).

Returns a newline-separated list of
``[SEVERITY] rule-id (line N): message`` entries, or a success
line.

Literal cmap/color names in conventional ax/plt plotting calls
(and imported pyplot aliases) are checked against live matplotlib
registries without executing source. Discover valid colormaps via
``sorted(matplotlib.colormaps)`` and named colors via
``matplotlib.colors.get_named_colors_mapping()``; existing tools
``get_color_value`` and ``list_color_families`` help inspect colors.
The resource ``dartwork-mpl://palette/colors`` lists exact package
color names and values.
For example, ``cmap="coolwarm"`` and ``color="dc.blue6"`` are valid.
Dynamic expressions and unknown receivers are left unchecked;
live custom names and explicit inline literal registrations are
accepted. Implicit/dynamic inline map registration defers map checks.
Direct named-color mapping updates and dynamic assignment keys
similarly defer color checks, while map checks still run.

lint_dartwork_mpl_code_json.description:
Lint Python source against the dartwork-mpl anti-pattern
catalog and return a structured JSON-friendly list of issues.

Each issue is a dict with keys:

- ``rule_id``: str (e.g. ``"figsize-direct"``)
- ``severity``: ``"critical" | "warning" | "info"``
- ``line``: int (1-based) or ``None``
- ``column``: int (absolute zero-based Python character offset within source) or ``None``
- ``message``: str
- ``fix_suggestion``: str | ``None``

Companion to :func:`lint_dartwork_mpl_code` which returns a
formatted text report for human reading. This tool is preferred
when an agent wants to programmatically pick fixes.

Valid names come from ``sorted(matplotlib.colormaps)`` and
``matplotlib.colors.get_named_colors_mapping()``. Literal checks
share the text tool's static scope and never execute source.

apply_lint_fixes.description:
Apply safe identifier-level rewrites for a curated subset
of lint rules, then return the fixed source plus the diff
between before/after lint runs.

Wraps :func:`dartwork_mpl.lint.apply_lint_fixes`. Currently
rewrites ``plt.style.use → dm.style.use`` and the no-arg
``plt.tight_layout() / fig.tight_layout()`` calls →
``dm.simple_layout(fig)``. Context-dependent rules (e.g.
``figsize-direct`` — which needs the agent to choose a width
and aspect token) are left untouched and surfaced in
``unfixed`` so the agent knows what's still pending.

migrate_legacy_code.description:
Rewrite 0.3-era dartwork-mpl source toward the 0.4 idioms.

Two passes are applied:

1. **Safe substitutions**: ``dm.cm2in`` → ``dm.cm``,
   ``plt.style.use`` → ``dm.style.use``.
2. **Hint comments** are inserted above lines using the
   context-dependent patterns the agent must rewrite by hand —
   the deprecated width tokens (``dm.SW``/``MW``/``TW``/``DW``,
   ``dm.FS_*``, ``dm.WIDTHS[...]``), the removed
   ``dm.subplots`` / ``dm.figure`` calls, bare
   ``figsize=(w, h)`` tuples, ``tight_layout()`` calls, and the
   removed ``dm.agent_utils`` / ``dm.xplot`` namespaces.

The output is always returned (never raises). Run
:func:`lint_dartwork_mpl_code_json` on the result to confirm no
critical issues remain after the agent applies the manual hints.
